Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1904

Report for the Year 1904 and Budget for the Year 1905
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1905

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the house-assessment lists, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs and the electricity charts are not. Printed pages 321–336 (part of the Works report) are missing from the scan. The scan is of lower resolution than later volumes. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (15 cells). The budget has its own page numbers, as printed.
